title: Reservation of rights to prehistoric and historic remains on leased public lands.
bodyText: The board of land and natural resources shall, in leases of public lands retain the rights to all prehistoric and historic remains found on such lands.
bodyHtml: [§171-36.1]  Reservation of rights to prehistoric and historic remains on leased public lands.  The board of land and natural resources shall, in leases of public lands retain the rights to all prehistoric and historic remains found on such lands. [L 1969, c 216, §7]
